dispositions.cleared: Provenance traced to public sources or to black-box observations with acquisition metadata, with nothing in the record tying the content to non-public source, disassembly or a tainted generator. A cleared input may enter the release source allowlist when its read disposition is port.
dispositions.tainted: The record ties the content to non-public source (the CRT files of the NT source tree), to a reverse-engineering pass whose records are not in any pinned repository, or to tainted code that it copies, exists to expose, or was generated by; nothing records an independent derivation. dispositions.unresolved: Provenance or license is not established either way by what this review read. Not a port source, not read for behaviour, and out of the release source allowlist until a later review clears it.

precedence: A module entry names one path at one blob and applies before any class; when the pinned blob differs from the reviewed one, the input is at least unresolved until the new blob is reviewed (a tainted entry stays tainted). Otherwise a witness_chain entry for the path at the pinned blob applies when the commits review clears the file on its own acquisition (cleared_as acquisition) and the file holds a retained witness's expected bits (one of the five answer captures, or the retention extended-numeric/numeric-outcomes.json), and otherwise the first class whose selector matches; such an entry takes precedence over every class (known_limits, dc-qfqa). Every other witness_chain entry (the scripts and modules of the chain) gives no disposition here. An input that the pin quarantines (the excel_numeric directory, or quarantine_derived) and that no entry matches is unresolved. Then the rules, by the orchestrator's content-derivation ruling of 2026-10-15 (see rules_note): at least unresolved for a citation sweep match of its own text (citation-sweep), a change by a listed tainted commit (tainted-commit; by the precedence change recorded on dc-m33w, which the orchestrator's ruling (b) after its round 2 limits to the files that hold expected bits, a file changed by a listed tainted commit stays at least unresolved unless a reviewed per-file entry, a witness_chain entry cleared on the file's own acquisition at its pinned blob for a file that holds a retained witness's expected bits, names that commit among its considered_commits; every other witness_chain entry, for a script or module of the chain and whatever its cleared_as, admits its file to the witness chain and changes nothing else) or an include macro the pin cannot read (unread-include); at least the disposition of every file its code includes (include-of-quarantined); and, for a file that only calls tainted or unresolved modules, no disposition but a calls_quarantined list (calls-quarantined). cargo xtask pin-sources and the numeric-provenance check of cargo xtask accept both derive this from the manifest's code_refs and content_facts, so a hand edit of an input's recorded numeric_provenance together with the allowlist fails the check; the check trusts those recorded facts themselves (the code edges, the sweep matches and the touched-by-commit lists), which the infra-m0.5 acceptance case recomputes from git for the sweep and the commits but not for the code edges. A cleared entry does not lift the pin's quarantine of an excel_numeric path; bead dc-ime9 owns that route.
limits: The numeric-provenance check of cargo xtask accept trusts the facts the manifest records per input: the code edges (code_refs), the citation sweep's matches and the touched-by-commit lists (content_facts), and the sets the tainted-commit rule finds at the pin (numeric_content.tainted_commit_rule). It recomputes every provenance and calls_quarantined list from them, never from the recorded numeric_provenance, but it cannot re-derive the facts without the legacy repositories; a coordinated edit of tainted_commits, of the manifest's recorded rule sets and of status.review.dispositions_hash passes it (known_limits).

The infra-m0.5 acceptance case (infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate) recomputes the citation sweep (git grep), the touched-by-commit lists (git diff-tree with rename following) and the tainted-commit rule's sets (git log) from the legacy repositories and spot-checks the cross-repository crate edges (git grep); its derivation of the calls_quarantined lists and of the include rule anchors on the manifest's in-repository code_refs, which only the pin computes.

Cross-repository edges are recorded at crate level, run-time loads are detected only in Rust code (fs::read, fs::read_to_string, fs::read_dir, File::open, OpenOptions, Command::new) and not resolved, and the edges into files that are not pinned inputs are not followed; the manifest and check summaries count them, and dc-4uy4 owns them.

A file is caught as a copy of a tainted function only by its own entry (odd-bond-family), not mechanically; the citation sweep is a fixed list of patterns; a commit outside the tainted list is not a taint route, and the list holds exactly what tainted_commit_rule gives.

The earlier review (wf_e1b320e3-3ab) gives no per-commit list: its entries other than the witness entries name 17 commits, 16 of them listed with a review record that cites that file and the 17th, ffcb9a77 (entry w111-frozen-numeric-copies), listed with the commits review's per-commit verdict; the check verifies each of the 16 against the text of the entries named; an omission of one of them is caught by the hash of the dispositions as reviewed, which covers every tainted_commits entry, and by the infra-m0.5 acceptance case, which reads the commits that review names in its entries with git.

rules_note: The orchestrator's ruling of 2026-10-15 on infra-m0.5 replaces round 2's transitive callers rule (entry numeric-callers): plan sections 1.1 and 12 quarantine derived material, a property of a file's own content. A file is at least unresolved when its own text matches the citation sweep, when a listed tainted commit changed it, or when its code holds an include macro the pin cannot read; it takes at least the disposition of every file it includes; a file that only calls a tainted or unresolved module keeps its own disposition and carries a calls_quarantined list (in its repository by file, in another repository by crate, and its run-time loads by repository), with which alone the release allowlist admits it. Cross-repository and run-time edges and the edges into files that are not pinned inputs (2 in OxFunc and 197 elsewhere when the ruling was made) are counted in the manifest summary and the check summary and owned by dc-4uy4.

witness_chain.rule: Each entry is a reviewed per-file entry of the commits review (wf_5ba77a06-ea9): the file at the blob that ran or was retained, its role, the review's reason verbatim, and the commits the review considered (considered_text verbatim, considered_commits resolved at the pin). The witness check of cargo xtask accept admits a file of a witness's chain only through its entry, and only when every listed tainted commit that changed it (as the manifest records under numeric_content.witness_chain, computed by cargo xtask pin-sources from git log of the path up to the entry's commit) is among its considered_commits and its blob matches no line of the citation sweep. An entry for a file that holds a retained witness's expected bits (a witness's source capture or its independent retention: the five answer captures and extended-numeric/numeric-outcomes.json) that the review clears on the file's own acquisition (cleared_as acquisition) also lifts the tainted-commit rule for its considered commits at a pinned input's blob (precedence). Every other entry, for a script or module of the chain, admits its file to the witness chain only, whatever its cleared_as, and says so in cleared_note: as a pinned input that file keeps the provenance the content rules give it (the orchestrator's ruling (b) after dc-m33w's round 2). The review gives each file cleared true and no cleared_as field; cleared_as records the review's wording: supplied_no_bits, the label of a restricted clearance, exactly when the review's reason opens with a sentence that starts with 'Cleared ' (its restricted clearances: 'Cleared as a copier of capture bits', 'Cleared only as a witness-chain dependency', 'Cleared as not having supplied or changed expected bits', 'Cleared as not having changed the retained bits'), acquisition otherwise; the cleared_note of a restricted clearance opens with the review's own qualification. cleared_as_basis quotes that opening sentence verbatim, and the check of cargo xtask accept compares both with the review file.
